justification: Both are worn stone carvings in shallow relief that include at least one human figure and a prominent circular element (a disc on the chest in A, a chariot wheel in B), and both use fine incised lines to indicate drapery or harness detail. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a tall, frontal, block-like single figure whose forms emerge from an irregular boulder-like mass, while B is a framed rectangular panel with a horizontal, multi-figure narrative in strict profile, so there is no correspondence of composition or handling.
